HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Caust.]
Roaring, tinkling, singing, humming, buzzing, chirping, whizzing, or pulsating in ears. θ Deafness. θ Rheumatism. θ Pertussis. θ Hemiplegia.
On turning head, cracking and snapping in ears. θ Deafness.
Reverberation of all sounds, even of the patient's own voice ; hears with difficulty.
Words and steps re-echo in ears.
She speaks low, because her own words appear to her very loud. θ Pregnancy.
Deafness. θ Otorrhœa. θ Facial hemiplegia. θ Rheumatism.
Stitches in right ear, paroxysmal, and in rapid succession.
Burning of ears ; they get red.
Hot pressure in ears and whole head, so that vision became dim.
Feeling of obstruction in ears, with offensive purulent discharge.
Itching in inner ear.
Diseases of middle ear, especially non-suppurative, when facial branch of seventh pair is involved.
Pinching in ear.
Offensive otorrhœa.
Eruptions on ear-lobe, and behind ears. θ Herpes. θ Impetigo capitis.
Accumulation of earwax, sometimes offensive in odor.
Pain in ear, as if something was trying to force out.
Dragging pain in ears. θ Toothache.
Dull pain in ears. θ Deafness.
Ears sensitive to the wind.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Caust.]
Blowing blood from nose mornings, or profuse nosebleed.
Blowing nose affects eye. See 5.
Epistaxis from left nostril.
Nosebleed during attack. θ Epilepsy.
Frequent sneezing, particularly in morning.
Frequent sneezing, with pain in chest. θ Influenza.
Dry coryza, with stoppage of nose.
Nose stopped up at night, running by day. θ Pertussis.
Fluent coryza, with pain in chest and limbs.
Acrid, burning discharge from nose. θ Influenza.
Coryza, with hoarseness, preventing loud speech.
Dryness of nose. θ Acne rosacea.
Puffiness of nose ; scrofulous swelling.
Itching of tip of nose and alæ, as well as inside.
Pimples, ulcers or crusts on tip of nose ; inflamed, swollen and scurfy.
Eruptions on nose, with burning. θ Acne rosacea. θ Eczema.
Eczema on nostrils.
Portion of left side and tip of nose eaten by an ulcer, covered with a thick crust. θ Lupus of nose.
Old warts on nose.
Nose and upper lip feel thick and heavy.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Caust.]
Pains in malar bones, zygomatic arch and maxillæ.
Drawing pains, which extend into cheek and ear, and are most apt to occur on right ride.
Burning in face.
Pains produce spasm of muscles, a sensation of numbness on side of face as if asleep.
Neuralgia : right side ; < at night, chilly, no thirst ; scanty menses ; left side > by rubbing part with a cloth dipped in cold water.
Facial neuralgia at every stormy change of weather ; attacks of unconsciousness while sitting, with set eyes and continued motion of muscles about mouth. θ Anemia.
Transient violent drawing pain in right cheek and then in ear.
Dragging pain in muscles of face. θ Toothache.
Face : yellow ; bluish-red ; sickly looking ; expression gloomy ; looks dissatisfied.
Yellow complexion, particularly on temples. θ Headache. θ Dentition. θ Ophthalmia scrofulosa. θ Uterine troubles. θ Scabies.
Paleness of face. θ Enuresis. θ Hemiplegia. θ Colic. θ Chorea.
Redness of face, with dulness in head.
Very red face during attack. θ Epilepsy.
Burning as of glowing coals in small spots in face, eyes, ears, and cheeks ; cannot move on account of pain.
Sudden shuddering in face, extending across chest or over back to knees.
Itching of face.
Red, erysipelatous swelling of cheek. θ Toothache.
Acne rosacea on cheeks and forehead ; in dispersed groups.
Moist, suppurating spot in centre of tetter on cheeks, enlarges, itches and burns, and becomes covered with a thick crust.
Pimples on left cheek with severe itching.
Hard pustules, with blackish centre, through beard. θ Acne.
Eruptions in face ; acne, burning and stinging.
Occasional spasmodic twitching of muscles on left side of face.
Paralysis of one side of face. θ Hemiplegia. θ Chorea. θ Otorrhœa. θ After cold.
Prosopalgia and rheumatism in face.
Severe tearing pains in left half of face. θ Facial neuralgia.
Upper lip and nose feel heavy.
Convulsive movements in muscles of face. θ Chorea. θ Risus sardonicus.
Contracts brows, with pain in head. θ Aphonia.
Her face feels to her like fur. θ Hemiplegia.
Shivering, beginning in face and spreading from it.
Serpiginous ulceration, with smarting and excoriation.
Warts on face.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Caust.]
Mouth drawn to one side. θ Hemiplegia.
Swelling of lower lip.
Tearing in diseased root of left lower jaw.
Jaws stiff and lame, not able to eat much for weeks. θ Bronchitis.
Sensation of tension and pain in jaws, could only with difficulty open mouth, and could not eat well, because a tooth seemed too long.
He could separate jaws only with great difficulty, and could not open mouth as usual ; it seemed as if throat below jaw was swollen or tense. θ Trismus. θ Tetanus.
Stitches in angle of right lower jaw. θ Hemiplegia.
Arthritic and rheumatic pains in lower jaw.
Drawing pain in glenoid cavity of jaw ; sensation as if jaw was contracted.
Warts on lips.
Ulcer on lower lip with burning pain, bleeds once in awhile.
Single red spots on chin spreading to nose and adjacent parts.
Froth at mouth. θ Spasms.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Caust.]
Dull stitches in upper back teeth, extending upward.
Boring pain in lower back teeth, extending downward.
Boring pain in lower back tooth, extending to nose and eye.
A painful prickling digging in lower back teeth, extending as far as ears.
Painful looseness and elongation of teeth.
Stitching and tearing toothache.
Tearing in both right rows of teeth, extending into zygoma ; both jaws of this side are painful to pressure, and on chewing feel as if bruised.
Sticking toothache.
Throbbing toothache, with painful gum, so that he could not chew.
Pain in sound teeth, on drawing in cold air.
Toothache during and after siesta in all stumps, > from cold water, < from smoke ; without violent pain, disagreeable sensation as though a foreign body was in them.
Long-lasting chronic toothache.
Burning pain in hollow teeth when eating and drinking.
Sensation as though blood would crowd into teeth, with burning stitching in fingers.
Grinding of teeth.
Offensive smell from teeth. θ Impetigo capitis.
Gum is painfully sensitive, without pain in teeth.
Swelling of gums, readily bleeding and tedious suppuration. θ Fistula dentalis.
Frequently recurring abscesses of gums.
